description: This file implements a scheduler policy for time-based Quality of Service (QoS) in a wireless communication system, including classes and functions for managing UE history, rate estimation, and priority computation for both uplink and downlink transmissions.

classes.name: ue_history_repository
classes.description: Manages UE history data including average rates and grants.

classes.name: rate_estimator
classes.description: Estimates maximum downlink and uplink transport block sizes based on cell configuration.

classes.name: scheduler_time_qos
classes.description: Implements a QoS-aware scheduler policy for downlink and uplink prioritization.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_dl_newtx_grants
methods.description: Updates DL rate statistics based on new grants.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_ul_newtx_grants
methods.description: Updates UL rate statistics based on new grants.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_dl_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum downlink transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_ul_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum uplink transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::compute_dl_prio
methods.description: Computes downlink priority for a UE based on QoS metrics.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::compute_ul_prio
methods.description: Computes uplink priority for a UE based on QoS metrics.
